ad_intro:
Why a performance-marketing audit includes the website: Meta does not make you money - the click does. CPL is paid on the ad; the conversion happens on the landing page, the form, WhatsApp speed-to-lead and the proof. MYSUN's problem is not the funnel design - it is that the brand is spread across three domains, one of which is dead, and the page that ranks for the biggest hook in the category publishes a factually wrong subsidy figure.

MYSUN, legal entity Eastern Light & Power Pvt. Ltd. (incorporated 23 Sep 2015), founded by Gagan Vermani (Founder & CEO, ex-MD/CEO SunBorne Energy) with Gyan Prakash Tiwari and Divyanshu Sachdev. Base Noida / Delhi NCR - the Day-1 file says New Delhi. Funding: $2.5M angel (Oct 2016, Hemant Taneja of General Catalyst joined the board), Rs.32 Cr / ~$4.2M pre-Series A (Apr 2020), Rs.15 Cr debt from Tata Cleantech Capital (Jul 2021, part of a $100M Green Climate Fund facility) - $9.37M total across 4 rounds; last raise was five years ago. Asset vehicle MYSUN+ was launched with a stated Rs.600 Cr first phase and a 200 MW pipeline. Present in 9 states. MCA: subsidiary ELP Solar One Pvt Ltd shows under Rs.10 Cr revenue FY25, 29 employees, 1-year profit CAGR -13%, and eight sibling ELP Solar entities are struck off. Day-1 file 14 Sep 2026: 4/10, ~3 ads, WhatsApp dest, pitch_fit HIGH.

Live check 14 Sep 2026: mysun.co returns HTTP 500 - the Day-1 file's primary domain is dead. The live site is itsmysun.com, and the subsidy page links out to a third domain, mysunn.in, for state-level subsidy content. What works is genuinely strong: a free Solar Savings Report calculator segmented residential vs industrial, Zero Cost EMIs / loans up to 60 months, MYSUN Deferred Payment (25-30% upfront), MYSUN Assured 25-year care, Flexi-pay booking at Rs.6,999, an AMC renewal product, a premium ARBOR / CANOPAS solar-pergola range, a dedicated PM Surya Ghar page with a Hindi version, photo testimonials with named customers, and two WhatsApp lines (9873167009 and a Wati chat widget on 9311988980).

What is broken: the PM Surya Ghar page states 'The government subsidy covers up to 40% of the installation costs' - the scheme pays fixed slabs, not a percentage - and its own subsidy table contradicts itself, listing '2kW - Rs 30,000 per kW - 60,000' alongside '3kW - Rs 18,000 for 2-3kW - 78,000', which does not add up as printed. Case studies are dated 2018; the press wall's newest item is Jul 2021; testimonial photos are from 2018 and 2023. Ad counts are Day-1 estimates. Never promise subsidy approval.

MYSUN passes (2) and (3) better than most of this cohort - two WhatsApp lines and photo testimonials. It fails (1) catastrophically if any legacy creative or backlink still points at mysun.co, which is returning HTTP 500.

findings: Your Day-1 primary domain is dead and the brand is split across three (verified 14 Sep 2026). mysun.co returns HTTP 500. The live site is itsmysun.com. The PM Surya Ghar page then links to a third domain, mysunn.in, for state subsidy content. Any legacy creative, backlink, business listing or QR code pointing at mysun.co is burning spend into a 500 error, and your Google Ads Transparency record is filed under a domain that no longer resolves. Pick one domain, 301 the others, and re-point every ad, listing and profile.

Your PM Surya Ghar page publishes an incorrect subsidy claim. The page states 'The government subsidy covers up to 40% of the installation costs'. PM Surya Ghar does not pay a percentage of cost - it pays fixed central assistance of Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000 for 1 / 2 / 3+ kW, by DBT, with scheme loans at 5.75%. This is the page you are trying to rank and convert on, and the headline number on it is wrong. It creates cancelled orders at DISCOM stage and, on paid traffic, it is a dispute waiting to happen.

The subsidy table contradicts itself in print. It lists '1kW - Rs 30,000 per kW - 30,000', then '2kW - Rs 30,000 per kW - 60,000', then '3kW - Rs 18,000 for 2-3kW - 78,000'. As printed, 2 kW at Rs 30,000 per kW plus Rs 18,000 does not produce 78,000 by the stated logic, and a reader cannot reconstruct the rule. State it plainly: Rs.30,000 for the first kW, Rs.30,000 for the second, Rs.18,000 for the third, capped at Rs.78,000 for 3 kW and above - plus the GHS/RWA rate of Rs.18,000 per kW. Add 'MNRE process; MYSUN does not approve subsidy'.

Day-1 leak confirmed: real proof, none of it in the creative, and all of it ageing. You have what most competitors do not - named photo testimonials (Sushil Sharma Greater Noida, Dr. Vishal Chhabra and Vikas Gera New Delhi), and marquee installs: 1.75 MWp Bhilwara, 397 kWp Chittor Polyfab, 231 kWp Update Prints, 35 kWp St. Xavier's Mumbai. But the case-study dates on site read 2018, the press wall's most recent logo is Jul 2021, and none of it appears in the ~3 live creatives. A 2018 case study on a 2026 landing page reads as 'this company stopped growing'.

Your calculator is the best asset in this Day-1 cohort and almost nothing is being sent to it. A free Savings Report segmented residential vs industrial, plus Zero Cost EMI, 60-month loans, 25-30% deferred payment and a Rs.6,999 Flexi-pay booking, is a stronger conversion stack than SolarSquare or Freyr publish. With only ~3 live creatives it is starved. Fire distinct pixel events on calculator-start, report-generated, WhatsApp-click and Flexi-pay-booking, then scale against report-generated. Also fix the 'might take a couple of minutes' loader - on mobile 4G that is where the report request dies.

Two WhatsApp numbers, one attribution mess. The floating button uses 9873167009; the Wati chat widget uses 9311988980; the subsidy page's confirmation screen quotes 9873167009. Three touchpoints, two numbers, no single tracked entry point. Consolidate to one WhatsApp Business number with click-to-WhatsApp ad routing and a per-source ref parameter, so you can finally attribute cost per conversation - which, at this spend level, is the only metric that matters.
